Who I am

Purposeful design,
clear direction.

I'm Lucas Macelloni — an Art Director and Graphic Designer based in São Paulo with 8+ years of experience. I work at the intersection of strategy and aesthetics, building brands and interfaces that communicate with clarity and intent.

I integrate AI tools, automation workflows, and advanced production methods directly into my process — without losing the craft. Whether you need a full visual identity, a product interface, or a motion piece, I'm committed to delivering work that is precise, considered, and built to last.

Also founder of Symbios, a creative agency focused on brand strategy and visual communication.
